name: Azar
description: Sahrmal's rash apprentice who cast a spell trapping his soul and Lim-Dûl's in his own body.

description_citations.text: "Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azar leaves sanctuary to defend Ardestan against Sahrmal's counsel, and Sahrmal and his other apprentice follow.
timeline.quote: Azar, unable to witness the suffering and inevitable fall of Ardestan without doing something about it, left their hidden sanctuary and went to the defense of the city.

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azar's spell and Lim-Dûl's counter trap both spirits in Azar's body; Sahrmal secretly buries it as the Great Barrier forms.
timeline.quote: The combined spells had the unforeseen effect of trapping both spirits within Azar's body.

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Wizards' War the five wizard schools resist Lim-Dûl, who is defeated; the Guardian imprisons his soul in an artifact.
timeline.quote: The Guardian removed Lim-Dûl's soul from Azar's body and imprisoned it within a magical artifact

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "The Wizards' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azar's empty body rises and becomes Lichlord Skavius Slan, ruling the Black Guild.
timeline.quote: it rose on its own and took the name Lichlord Skavius Slan .

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "The Wizards' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azar casts a spell to imprison Lim-Dûl's spirit and create the Great Barrier, but both spirits become trapped in Azar's body.
timeline.quote: The combined spells had the unforeseen effect of trapping both spirits within Azar’s body.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azar falls and Lim-Dûl resumes his campaign, but is finally defeated in the Wizard's War and his soul imprisoned in the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: imprisoned it within the Chain Veil , a magical artifact that kept the Great Barrier intact

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Lim-Dûl", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Since his apparent death, he had been training two adepts.

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "Lim-Dûl's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Sahrmal's oldest apprentice who traps Lim-Dûl's spirit within his own body to create the Great Barrier.
